hazards.control: Flare and tanks sited downwind; hot work controls; static bonding on tanks and lines.

name: Flare stack
function: The stack with an igniter that burns gas from the separator during flowback until the sales line takes it.

tabs.overview: Gas from the separator is piped to a vertical stack sited downwind with a pilot or electronic igniter; a knockout pot removes liquids first. Height and distance follow the site plan and radiant heat calculations.
tabs.engineering: Knockout, igniter, and flame detection; sized for the maximum gas rate.
tabs.connections: Separator gas outlet; knockout drain to a tank.
tabs.safety: Radiant heat and flammable gas; siting and wind; ignition confirmed before flow.
tabs.evidence: Public flowback and well testing overview (S25), field practice (S9).
tabs.operations: Lit before the well is opened; monitored continuously.
